blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — What was meant to be a simple video of a police officer providing safety reminders has become the internet’s newest target for collective swooning. The cop has drawn witty but not-so-“marked safe” comments from netizens admiring his looks and who are suddenly very eager to be detained. Police Lieutenant Mar Joseph Reburiano, officer-in-charge of the Caramoran Municipal Police Station in Catanduanes, shared tips in a Facebook video post on staying safe at home and in public.
